items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I studied with Slosberg in New York. And he taught the whole brass section of Phil Harmony.

ctx.x: You never know it if you don't, and the way you play, it sounds all right to me. Did you study much? You say you had some regular formal lessons, like-

Oh, yes. I studied with Eddie Llewellyn, the Chicago Symphony, with Noah Tarantino. He played first trumpet with the opera. Yeah. I studied with Slosberg in New York. And he taught the whole brass section of Phil Harmony.

Oh, really? Mm-hmm. I'm familiar with all those names, but... Is there anything else about George Brunis, working with him, that you remember in particular during Ted Lewis days, or even that first band, anything that he impressed you? I know he never did really learn to read, I guess, in his life already, did he?
